name: Beast King

skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in a row with a 5-hit combo, dealing 24% ATK DMG per hit (120% ATK total), with a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target for 2 turn(s).[Injured]: When attacked, takes additional Injury DMG equal to 50% ATK.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in a row with a 5-hit combo, dealing 24% ATK DMG per hit (120% ATK total), with a 100% chance to inflict [Injured] on the main target and a 50% chance to inflict [Injured] on enemies in the main target's row for 2 turn(s).[Injured]: When attacked, takes additional Injury DMG equal to 50% ATK.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP%. Whenever an ally attacks a target inflicted with [Injured], Beast King launches a [Follow-up] against that target (attacking with 80% of Basic Attack's DMG and effects, up to 3 times each turn).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP%. Whenever an ally attacks a target inflicted with [Injured], Beast King launches a [Follow-up] against that target (attacking with 80% of Basic Attack's DMG and effects, up to 3 times each turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP%. Whenever an ally attacks a target inflicted with [Injured], Beast King launches a [Follow-up] against that target (attacking with 110% of Basic Attack's DMG and effects, up to 3 times each turn).

effects.desc: Extra attack outside of turn. Disabled by [Lock] and [Blind].

bondList: Deep Sea King + Sky King + Subterranean King
